name: click-to-copy
description: A [ copy ] button under every fenced code block in Claude's replies, with the exact text it will copy beside it. One click puts the command on your clipboard as a one-liner. Also tells Claude to fence commands instead of suggesting the `!` prefix.

oneLine.title: One-liner join
oneLine.description: How a multi-line block is flattened before it is copied. and joins the lines with ' && '; semicolon joins them with '; '; off keeps the newlines. Backslash line continuations are always unwrapped.

fences.title: Which blocks get a button
fences.description: all draws a button under every fenced block; shell only under blocks tagged bash, sh, zsh, shell, console, fish or untagged.

stripPrompt.title: Strip shell prompts
stripPrompt.description: Remove a leading '$ ' or '% ' prompt from each copied line.

promptRule.title: Ask Claude to fence commands
promptRule.description: Add a short system-prompt section telling Claude to put commands you should run yourself in a fenced bash block, one per block, instead of suggesting the `!` prefix. Off leaves the system prompt alone.
